rubrics.justification: It matches the reported 2AB in broad terms, but adds several likely fabricated image findings (micro-fragmentation, vacuolation, granular debris, irregular epithelial junctions, asymmetric ICM concern) that are not reliably supportable from a single embryo image.
It integrates age, BMI, AMH, tubal factor, prior cycle, semen parameters, and endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis reasonably well, though some links are overstated.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is explained, but several deductions are weak or overstated, especially the morphology-based penalties and assumptions about DOR affecting quality in this young patient.

Core recommendations like proceeding with single embryo transfer are guideline-consistent, but ERA/EMMA/ALICE after only one failed cycle, DHEA, melatonin, and some adjuvant suggestions are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management and future workup, though some suggested tests/interventions may be premature or not evidence-based for this scenario.
